postImportFinding.finding: The production manifests and game/main.gd were preserved, but the fourteen raster outputs and three bundled font files named by the production inventory were not included in the rejected candidate's structured artifact list before cleanup.
postImportFinding.recovery: The DejaVu font files and license were recovered byte-for-byte from the installed matplotlib distribution. design/recovery/runtime-bootstrap.json records a compile-only whole-scene background plus transparent raster shims so Godot can prove the recovered logic. Every mismatched raster must be target-linked, replaced, preserved, and reverified before production acceptance.
